# axiolid-exact-arrangement

Exact arrangement of straight segments on rational points, with face tracing.

## Overview

An exact arrangement of straight segments in the plane. Points are rational (homogeneous coordinates over exact dyadic numbers), so every orientation, order and containment decision is an exact sign: segments are cut at every crossing, T-junction and collinear overlap into pieces that no other piece crosses, equal points are joined, and rings of caller-labelled half-edges are traced and nested into outer boundaries with holes. No tolerance enters. Only the points a caller finally returns are rounded, once each.

It is the shared source of truth for those signs: the plane section of `axiolid-reference` (in-plane faces, ADR 0093) and the visible faces of `axiolid-hidden-lines` (ADR 0094) both decide on it. It knows no mesh, no plane and no face; callers label the pieces. For an editable subdivision with persistent handles, use `axiolid-arrangement`; for polygon booleans with a tolerance, use `axiolid-overlay`.
